Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.

When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.

Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.

Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.

Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.

While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.

Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.

Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.

Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.

Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.

After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.

Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.

Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
